## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D3. No audit backlog id. Created from the audit's rulings and blueprint, not from a backlog line (see Findings).

Persona and route: Every page title, card surface and page-level message · web/clinic and web/platform-admin.
Findings and reviewers: F-19, F-44 · reviewers B-10, B-16, B-22, B-26, C-04, C-22. From the blueprint's Next list and guardrails; no UX number of its own in the backlog.
Rationale: 37 hand-written page titles at seven different heights, 97 inline card strings, 10 local Message functions. The platform console does not use the shared page header, so library fixes do not reach it; its sign-in overflows at 375 px.
Proposed UX behaviour: Every page uses PageHeader (one 44 px row; content starts at about 124 px); the small label above the title goes where it only repeats the menu item; the date is secondary text, not part of the title. Inline card strings become Card or Section in the two sizes; no bordered card inside a bordered card. The local Message and Empty functions become PageMessage and EmptyState. The platform console adopts PageContainer and PageHeader, and its sign-in no longer overflows at 375 px. On the patients directory, search and filters sit on one 44 px row and repeated cell labels go. The ratchet counts for raw h1, border bg-card, and local Message, Card and Empty fall to zero and the lint rules turn to error.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/08-design-system-blueprint.md sections 2 and 7.
Components and tokens affected: PageHeader, Card, Section, PageMessage, EmptyState.
Front end and back end split: Front end only. By codemod where identical, by hand elsewhere; one feature group per pull request.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the shell components and page components tickets. Timing: after the first pilot weeks, or before the first staff training session if the founder moves it there; never between training and the first two pilot weeks (arbitration ruling 6). Where a track S or wave D2 ticket already touches a file, it replaces that file's local Message or Card itself.
Clinical sign-off: Not required.
Effort and regression risk: M · Medium: page titles are test locators in many specs.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Renaming any page (the names ticket). (2) Layout redesign.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given every page in both apps at 1440, when the title is measured, then it sits in a 44 px header row at the same height and content starts within 130 px of the top
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the board and My day, when data loads, then the title and actions do not move
- [ ] **AC3.** Given features, when the ratchet runs, then raw h1, border bg-card, and local Message, Card and Empty are all zero and their lint rules are errors
- [ ] **AC4.** Given the platform console sign-in at 375 px, when it renders, then page width equals viewport width and controls are at least 44 px
- [ ] **AC5.** Given the patients directory at 1024 by 768, when it opens, then the first row starts at or above 300 px
- [ ] **AC6.** Given English and Arabic, when axe runs on each migrated page, then there is no violation and each page has one h1

## Test notes

- tests/e2e/page-layout.spec.ts extended: header position on every route.
- platform-console.spec.ts at 375.
- All suites green per feature group.

## Notes / open questions

- Regression risk: medium.
